content_sections.heading: Mumbai Port Authority Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the Mumbai Port Authority Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download Mumbai Port Authority Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Specialist (Radiology): M.B.B.S. degree of a statutory university and MD/DNB in Radiology, M.B.B.S. with Diploma in Radiology or equivalent. Experience: Minimum one year of experience as a Medical Officer in a recognized hospital. Specialist (Gen. Surgery): M.B.B.S. degree of a statutory university and MS/DNB/Post Graduate Degree in General Surgery. Experience: Minimum one year of experience as a Medical Officer in a recognized hospital. Specialist (Medicine): M.B.B.S. with MD/DNB (Medicine) or equivalent. Experience: Minimum one year of experience as a Medical Officer in a recognized hospital. General Duty Doctor: M.B.B.S. degree of a statutory university. Experience: Minimum one year of experience as a Medical Officer in a recognized hospital.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: General Candidates with Post Graduation: Maximum age 50 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved category candidates in accordance with applicable Government guidelines. General Candidates with MBBS Degree: Maximum age 45 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved category candidates in accordance with applicable Government guidelines.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Mumbai Port Authority Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Mumbai Port Authority to hire qualified medical professionals for various specialist and general duty doctor roles on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in Mumbai Port Authority Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available across different medical specialist and general duty posts as per the official notification details.

faq.question: Q3. What are the posts available in this recruitment drive?
faq.answer: The available posts include Specialist (Radiology), Specialist (Gen. Surgery), Specialist (Medicine), and General Duty Doctor under the healthcare field.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree with a Diploma, Degree, MD, or DNB in the relevant discipline from a recognized statutory university along with relevant experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for general candidates applying with post-graduation?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for general candidates applying with a post-graduation qualification is 50 years, with relaxations applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for candidates applying with an MBBS degree?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for general candidates applying with a basic MBBS degree for general duty doctor roles is 45 years, with applicable category relaxations.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 1,26,000/- up to Rs. 1,60,000/- depending on the specific post and qualification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for Mumbai Port Authority Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection of candidates for these contract posts will be done purely through a Walk-in Interview process conducted directly at the designated venue.

faq.question: Q9. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 07 October 2026 at 11:00 AM at the specified Mumbai Port Authority hospital venue.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the walk-in interview venue located?
faq.answer: The interview will take place at the 1st Floor, Near to Chief Medical Officer's cabin, Mumbai Port Authority Hospital, Nadakarni Park, Wadala (East) Mumbai - 400 037.
